name: Detective pony
tips: Before you report a bug, search the issues, closed ones too: the answer may already be there.
On GitHub, remove `is:open` from the Issues search box to search the closed issues too.
A closed issue isn't always fixed: read the last comments. Solved, refused, or a duplicate?
personal: Elementary! The answer was in a closed issue all along.
Every clue counts. Even the old, closed ones.
I never open a case before I read the old ones.
